name: summarize-completeness
description: Quickstart eval: run the fanout-summarize pipeline against the quickstart-summarize dataset, score each row's summary for completeness against the expected one-sentence target.

scorers.criteria: Does the OUTPUT cover the same facts as EXPECTED? A perfect summary will mention every concrete claim (numbers, names, conditions, dates) that EXPECTED includes. Missing one concrete claim = 0.5; missing two or more = 0.0.
